notes.title: Dawnbreaker Aeon’s Reach - Official Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/9a9cd0468d50aebb0836a5f87a2428390a91c24e.png

CrazySky3D’s new Visual Novel, Dawnbreaker - Aeon’s Reach will launch on Steam for Windows and Linux on November 5th 2021.

Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach is an erotic visual novel that puts you in the heels of a jaded bounty hunter looking for fun, causing her to embark on a very hot cosmic adventure with a bunch of outlaws. Will you be able to find what you desire in this universe?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/cfa7210538d726ec4b33737edc30ad2bd5c4295e.jpg

Features

A lewd story around 50k+ words long (from 5 to 6 hours of gameplay)
Multiple paths with several different endings
A whole cast of sensual girls for you to meet
4k high-quality graphics
300+ unique CGs with animations
Detailed 3D backgrounds with multiple variations
Image gallery, music room, and replay scene functionality
Achievements, Easter eggs, and more!
